• Glulam GL24h (EN 14080), service class 3 — use durable-species lamellas (larch/Douglas) or treated; oil

• Front beam 140x360 span 4.1 m: M ≈ 9 kNm, σ ≈ 3 MPa ≪ 17 MPa.
• Ledger 90x315: 2 M16 resin anchors @ 600 into RC ring beam (survey!).

diagonal tie-rods in roof plane if engineer requires.

• LPG 2 x 11 kg in ventilated cupboard (low-level vents), regulator, hose ≤ 1.5 m; or natural gas by Gas
